_comment: This file no longer decides which database a run uses, and must never carry a credential. Runs default to LocalDB, which needs no user and no password. To target Azure for a run, set VENU_TEST_TARGET=azure in the environment; the credentials come from Key Vault kv-vennusign-dev (sql-dev-server, sql-dev-database, sql-dev-username, sql-dev-password). Override the vault with VENU_TEST_AZURE_KEY_VAULT.
